name: Heartbreak High: A Break-Up Simulator
source:
Imagine you're the most popular kid in school. So popular, in fact, that you're dating every single person in your class. The only problem? You've decided to break up with all of them, one by one.

[From [url=https://alecrobbins.itch.io/heartbreakhigh] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想象一下，你是学校里最受欢迎的学生。受欢迎到和班上的每个人都在交往。唯一的问题是，你决定把他们一个接一个地甩掉。

[来源：[url=https://alecrobbins.itch.io/heartbreakhigh]itch.io[/url]]
